note: Machine-readable mirror of the design doc's provider table, for humans to review -- cli.py currently routes by the provider_* prefix in config/panel.json directly, not by reading this file, so a change here does not by itself change executor behavior. Kept as the single reviewable statement of intent.

provider_a_automationdirect.rationale: No confirmed public self-serve API; a real but unverified API signal exists (an on-site 'Product API' reference and a community-forum thread this session could not reach). Gated by a reachability + robots.txt probe (automationdirect.py) before any capture is attempted.

provider_b_grainger.rationale: No public self-serve API found; only punchout/EDI for enterprise procurement accounts (4-6 week setup, not viable within a 30-day trial). HTML risk against likely enterprise-grade bot management unverified. Never automated.

provider_c_mcmaster.rationale: Publishes a 'Product Information API' (mcmaster.com/help/api/) explicitly for approved procurement customers only, not public self-serve signup. Industry reputation for aggressive anti-automation measures. Never automated.

provider_d_digikey.rationale: Confirmed public, self-serve developer portal (developer.digikey.com), Product Information V4 with real-time pricing and availability.

provider_e_mouser.rationale: Confirmed public, free, self-serve Search API (mouser.com/api-hub) explicitly returning price, availability, and lead time in one documented schema -- the most complete single-call match of the five providers.
